profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Hello! As a passionate Full Stack Developer, I specialize in crafting comprehensive web solutions using a robust tech stack that includes JavaScript, React, Node.js, and Express. My focus is on delivering functional, user-centric applications that offer engaging and intuitive user experiences.

My experience thrives in collaborative settings, where I excel in problem-solving and ensuring seamless integration within diverse teams. My recent engagement in a notable open-source project underscores my adaptability and commitment to enhancing community-driven outcomes, demonstrating my ability to navigate and contribute to complex codebases effectively.

I pride myself on delivering high-quality work from the initial concept to final deployment, positioning myself as a dependable member of any development team. 

Explore my latest projects and contributions at https://github.com/eunykim92.

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description:
• Developed a responsive wedding photography site on Webflow, adding custom video modals, hover effects, and smooth transitions to enhance interactivity.
• Launched a high-impact tire company website with a modern layout, hero video, CMS-driven product pages, and a downloadable catalog, optimized for all devices.
• Integrated Google Analytics on the tire website, tracking 100 new users in two weeks, and used insights to refine the user experience.
• Utilized a serverless architecture to integrate Webflow's API, enabling automated data retrieval and updates, enhancing site performance and scalability
• Refined site performance through CSS and JavaScript tweaks, ensuring fast load times and seamless functionality across devices.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed a drawing interface with Konva.js, enabling users to create and manipulate components, boosting engagement and creativity.
• Engineered and maintained a PostgreSQL database schema, ensuring efficient data storage and retrieval while upholding data integrity and performance.
• Oversaw AWS deployment, leveraging EC2 and RDS to ensure scalable, reliable hosting infrastructure.
• Implemented Redux for centralized state management, improving scalability by 25% and ensuring consistent state across the application.
• Optimized system performance by enhancing back-end operations with Node.js and Express, achieving a 30% reduction in latency and ensuring real-time data processing.
• Crafted responsive layouts with CSS, maintaining visual consistency and a seamless user experience across all components.
• Configured Docker for containerization, ensuring consistent environments across development and production, leading to improved scalability and simplified configuration.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · React.js · Redux · PostgreSQL · Konva · Material UI · AWS S3 · TypeScript · Jest · Express.js · OAuth · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Docker

positions.title: Software Developer | It’s Okay to Not Be Okay | Mental Health Journal Web App
positions.description:
• Utilized React Router DOM for seamless, multi-page-style navigation, enhancing user experience.
• Constructed back-end with Node.js and Express, handling CRUD operations for journal entries with high performance.
• Optimized data management using Mongoose and MongoDB, ensuring robust session handling and data integrity.

positions.title: Software Developer | Wobbedrobe | Wardrobe Tracking Web App
positions.description:
• Created a responsive React interface, allowing real-time wardrobe tracking with dynamic updates for users.
• Handled application state with Redux Toolkit, improving scalability and reducing complexity in debugging.
• Accelerated load times with Webpack’s code-splitting capabilities, optimizing app performance for faster page loads.

positions.title: Loan Partner
positions.description: • Developed customized debt reduction strategies for 50+ clients, providing guidance to improve loan eligibility and fiscal health, empowering clients to achieve financial goals.

positions.title: Mortgage Loan Originator
positions.description: • Generated over $1MM in monthly mortgage sales by cultivating relationships across departments and communication channels, establishing a robust sales pipeline.

positions.title: Sales Manager
positions.description:
• Facilitated strategic discussions on new contracts and sales targets, aligning team objectives with corporate goals, resulting in a 15% increase in product offerings and innovation.
• Collaborated with high-profile fashion businesses such as Fashion Nova, processing orders and providing samples from the showroom, contributing to an average of $500,000 in annual sales.
